newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-PEDROS MAY LEAVE MARSEILLE FOR PARMA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PEDROS MAY LEAVE MARSEILLE FOR PARMA.

text.p: French international striker Reynald Pedros, unimpressive this season with Marseille, may leave the former European champions to join Parma, sports daily l'Equipe said on Tuesday.
"Parma are interested and his transfer is in the pipeline," Marseille president Jean-Michel Roussier told l'Equipe.
He said he was only waiting for "a reasonable offer" from the Italian club before the Wednesday deadline for transfers in Italy.
Pedros, a gifted but moody 24-year-old playmaker and striker, joined Marseille from Nantes at the start of the season.
